title: Owner-gated secret containment and Harness content scanning
objective: After the Owner confirms external credential rotation, remove the exposed credential from repository material and add redacting content-based secret detection so ordinary documentation cannot bypass Harness integrity checks.
forbidden_actions: Do not read, print, copy or write the secret value into logs, tests, task artifacts, commits or reports.
Do not rotate, revoke or validate an external credential until the Owner explicitly authorizes it.
Do not rewrite Git history without a separate explicit Owner authorization and recovery plan.
Do not weaken the existing stage locks or secret checks.
